title: Code and per-seed results for: Zero-Shot Low-Rank Compression of Tabular Neural Networks via Marchenko-Pastur Tail-Quantile Spectral Thresholding
description: Notebooks with saved outputs, per-seed results of the bias-correction ablation, and the figure script accompanying the manuscript on zero-shot low-rank compression of tabular neural networks via Marchenko-Pastur tail-quantile spectral thresholding.
